description: CITTA METROPOLITANA MILANO - Sintesi rilievi traffico strade provinciali fino al 2014 is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Lombardia. Fino al 2014 la Provincia di Milano effettuava conteggi di traffico sulle strade gestite con apparecchi fissi e mobili. Il servizio a causa della obsolescenza degli impianti è stato abbandonato. La mappa consente di visualizzare una sintesi dei dati storici rilevati. Coverage: Regione Lombardia. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Lombardia. Its tags are provincia-milano, strade, traffico. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, KML, KMZ, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
